definition: Elizabeth DuRoss Liddy (May 12, 1944 – August 21, 2025) was an American computer scientist and academic who was professor of information science and dean of the Syracuse University School of Information Studies.
details: She was a pioneer in the field of natural language processing.

explainer.lead: Liz Liddy was an American computer scientist (1944–2025).

timeline.what: Liddy was born in Dayton, Ohio, on May 14, 1944, and grew up in Utica, New York.
She joined the Syracuse University School of Information Studies in 1983, where she started a graduate program in library science.
In 1994 Liddy was the founding President of TextWise, a semantics-based search engine.
She left TextWise in 1999, after growing the number of employees to over 50.
